feedback: The test cases fully cover the requirement to support nested parentheses by evaluating expressions with multiple levels of parentheses and mixed operations. Each test case validates correct operator precedence, left-to-right evaluation for same precedence, and proper handling of nested structures. The mathematical reference checks confirm the expected outputs are accurate. All tests are scoped to the requirement and include a variety of operation types (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and nesting depths. Coverage is sufficient and aligned with the customer intent.
